It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
